fields.title: 6. Triggers
fields.md:
- **T1**: Added to check: 'whether the Customer A (U.S. government) line drops below 10% and disappears from the 10-K customer concentration note — the only disclosure checkpoint for the CEO's 11/6 claim. If it disappears, the A-2032-1 measurement switches to the 10-K government revenue narrative' · 'Google appears as a new line if it exceeds 10%'. The monitor's T1 linkage **was correct this time** (the 4Q earnings disclosure is the checkpoint) (Source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T1]`).
- **T3**: Expected date 11/8 → **11/14 (KST, NET 11/13 22:45 UTC + 1 day)** · backup 11/20 · checkpoint 12/01. The erroneous premise 'planned date = launch date' recorded in prev. Primary detection is the LL2 measurement layer (Source: Section 3).
- **T6**: Status records Harrison's resignation and the reported 6-member special committee; added to check: 'committee size, independence and filling of the Class B vacancy after the resignation · Tesla 12/3 shareholder meeting proxy (no merger agenda item, per reports)' (Source: Section 2).
- **T7**: Expected date 11/6 → **11/13 (KST, ⓓ briefing 11/12 + 1 day) → 11/19 → 2027-1H**. Paths ⓓ·ⓔ status 'deadline lapsed — no public answer found'. Non-response is not 'refusal' but 'not disclosed' (Source: Section 3).
- **T4**: Vulcan LV-01 'Go for Launch' on 11/13 recorded, no change · **T2**: one month before the 12/8 lockup (up to 797.6 million shares) — no change · **T5·T8·T9·T10·T11**: no change (Source: `state.triggers_next_12m` · `data/spacex_watch.json launches.competitor_next`).
